releasesInRange.body:
## New Features

- GPT-6.1 Sol is now the default model in the bundled and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#49318, #49339)
- Amazon Bedrock supports multi-agent V2 and Ultra reasoning on compatible models; Bedrock Mantle also accepts AWS GovCloud regions. (#49345, #49813)
- Sign in to MCP servers from an active terminal session with `/mcp login <name>`. (#49290)
- Choose your microphone, speaker, and microphone input channels for voice conversations, with preferences saved locally. (#49437, #49836)
- Daybreak is opt-in through `--enable cli_daybreak` or `features.cli_daybreak=true`; `daybreak=true` alone is insufficient. By default, controls and indicators are hidden, `/daybreak` is unavailable, and automatic Cyber routing is omitted—even for saved Daybreak threads. Saved preferences remain intact. Opt-in routing requires eligible ChatGPT sign-in, the OpenAI provider, and advertised model/program support. (#49856, #49858, #49859, #49861, #51207)
- Select a Cyber access program per turn with `codex exec --cyber-access-program` or the TypeScript SDK’s `cyberAccessProgram` option. The explicit exec override remains available with `cli_daybreak` disabled and leaves the saved choice unchanged. (#49939, #51207)

## Bug Fixes

- Approved filesystem escalation can now grant broader write access while preserving denied reads and network restrictions. Background tasks retain their originating turn’s permissions. (#49353, #49880)
- Explicit launch permissions survive terminal reconnects and new sessions, while implicit client settings no longer overwrite server or saved-thread web-search settings. (#49809, #49799)
- Elevated Windows terminal sessions can start using an embedded server, and sandboxed PowerShell preserves relative paths beneath protected user profiles. (#49855, #49690)
- Enter correctly submits buffered input after paste detection expires, including in Vim insert mode. (#49810)
- Thread resume includes the latest committed history. Startup detects recoverable SQLite corruption earlier and preserves damaged databases as backups. (#49599, #49701)
- Responses retries and WebSocket-to-HTTP fallback honor server retry guidance, reducing premature failures during overload. (#49441)

## Documentation

- Authentication guidance now accounts for keyring storage instead of implying credentials always reside in `auth.json`. (#49361)

## Chores

- Publishing an older alpha or hotfix no longer moves npm alpha tags backward. (#49704)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.160.0...rust-v0.161.0

- #49261 Preserve Windows sandbox runner launch errors @zm-oai

- #49266 Remove the remote agent message boar

## New Features

- Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)
- Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)
- Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)
- Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)
- Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)
- Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

## Bug Fixes

- Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)
- Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)
- Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)
- Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)
- Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)
- Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)

## Chores

- Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
- Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

prs.title: Ignore ripgrep configuration when expanding sandbox deny globs
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Ignore ripgrep configuration when expanding sandbox deny globs

## Why

User ripgrep configuration can suppress the file list used to construct Linux sandbox deny masks. For example, `--quiet` in `RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH` can leave files matching deny globs unmasked.

## What changed

Pass `--no-config` to the ripgrep invocation that expands denied-file globs.

## Testing

Extend the multiple-denied-files regression test with a ripgrep configuration containing `--quiet`, checking that denied files remain unreadable and unwritable while allowed files remain accessible. Skip the ripgrep-specific case when no protected `rg` executable is available.

prs.title: Add completion-aware realtime attachment and session-scoped detach
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add completion-aware realtime attachment and session-scoped detach

## Why

A delayed detach or cleanup from an older realtime conversation must not close its replacement or end the replacement's history segment. Realtime start parameters can also contain credentials in text and transport endpoints, so diagnostics should avoid exposing them.

## What changed

- Add `RealtimeConversationAttach` to report the connection attempt's result through a reply channel, using the sequential start path.
- Add `RealtimeConversationDetach` to close only the matching `realtime_session_id` after earlier starts finish. Detaching an older session leaves the replacement connected.
- Emit the previous conversation's close event before starting its replacement, and prevent stale fanout cleanup from closing or clearing the replacement's context.
- Limit `ConversationStartParams` debug output to output modality, initial item count, and protocol version.

## Testing

Add coverage for attachment completion after the handshake, stale detaches, failed replacement and retry, natural-close ordering, handoff history after replacement, and debug redaction for existing-call and WebRTC transports.

prs.title: Add a Windows MXC sandbox opt-out
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add a Windows MXC sandbox opt-out

## What changed

Add `windows.allow_mxc` to configuration and its JSON schema. Setting it to `false` blocks automatic MXC selection even when `features.prefer_mxc` is enabled, and rejects explicit `windows.sandbox = "mxc"` configuration with a clear error. Omitting the setting preserves existing behavior.

## Testing

Extend configuration tests to cover disabling automatic MXC selection and rejecting explicit MXC configuration when `windows.allow_mxc = false`.

prs.title: Complete dynamic tool lifecycles on cancellation
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Complete dynamic tool lifecycles on cancellation

## Why

Interrupting a turn or terminating a Code Mode cell can drop a pending dynamic tool handler before it publishes its completion. Cancellation needs to settle the call in live events and persisted history without allowing a late response into model context.

## What changed

- Let dynamic tool handlers observe cancellation and publish their terminal item before dispatch finishes. Calls cancelled while awaiting a response complete with a failed item and a cancellation error.
- Keep readiness, dispatch admission, registry lock waits, hooks, and output processing cancellable so cancellation can finish even when a hook is blocked.
- Report an aborted tool lifecycle outcome when cancellation interrupts dispatch, including before handler execution.

## Testing

Add regression tests for turn interruption with pending calls or blocked hooks, cell termination with persisted failure and late-response exclusion, cancellation before dispatch admission, and exactly one completion when a response races cancellation.

prs.title: Expose package assembly helpers and support gzip DotSlash artifacts
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Expose package assembly helpers and support gzip DotSlash artifacts

## What changed

- Extract `create_parser()`, `assemble_package()`, and `archive_package()` from the packaging CLI so callers can assemble a package directory, add files, and archive it separately.
- Support DotSlash artifacts with `format: "gz"` by decompressing the executable directly to its destination.

## Testing

Extend the zsh manifest override test to verify executable contents for both `tar.gz` and `gz` artifacts.

prs.title: Add thread ID exclusions to `thread/list`
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add thread ID exclusions to `thread/list`

## Why

Clients displaying a saved manual thread order need to list the remaining threads without repeating those already loaded separately.

## What changed

Add optional `excludedThreadIds` to `thread/list` and the generated protocol bindings. Apply exclusions before the result limit, refilling pages until the requested limit is reached or history is exhausted while preserving existing filters and ordering. Clients must send the same exclusions on each page.

Accept up to 100 entries, counting duplicates toward the bound. Reject invalid IDs or oversized lists with JSON-RPC error `-32602` rather than truncating them. Omitted, null, and empty lists preserve existing behavior.

## Testing

Add integration coverage for page refill across database-only and scan/repair paths, archived threads, sort directions, and project/section scopes. Cover duplicate and unknown IDs, the 100-entry boundary, invalid input, and preservation of section order.

prs.title: Distinguish thread listing failures from exhausted history
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Distinguish thread listing failures from exhausted history

## Why

DB-only listing and pagination failures must not look like exhausted history. This hardens the DB-only listing added in https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/18502 and page refilling added in https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/7509.

## What changed

- Return JSON-RPC error `-32603` when `useStateDbOnly: true` cannot query the local state database, including requests with an empty `cwd` array.
- Track all cursors encountered while filling a page and return `-32603` for repeated cursors, including on full pages.
- Document that callers can retry these errors; a successful response with `nextCursor: null` still indicates exhaustion. Default scan-and-repair requests retain their filesystem fallback.

## Testing

Add regression tests for missing or mismatched state databases versus healthy empty history, with active and archived listings and null or empty `cwd` filters. Cover repeated cursors during page refilling and on full pages using the in-memory thread store.

prs.title: Signal abandonment of unanswered MCP elicitations
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Signal abandonment of unanswered MCP elicitations

## Why

Published MCP elicitation requests could lose their response waiter without notifying the event consumer that the request was no longer answerable.

## What changed

- Add `ElicitationAbandoned` with the original server name and response token for requests published through unbounded event channels.
- Emit abandonment exactly once when a waiter is dropped, response delivery fails, or the MCP runtime shuts down.
- Close the elicitation router during shutdown, reject new requests on unbounded sources, and wait for terminal deliveries before shutdown completes. Preserve bounded sources' request-only behavior and backpressure.

## Testing

Add router tests for ordered, exactly-once abandonment, closed receivers, failed response delivery, shutdown coordination, and bounded-channel backpressure. Add a core integration scenario verifying that a pending form's abandonment precedes `ShutdownComplete`.

prs.title: Stabilize Guardian snapshot prefixes by separating assistant context
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Stabilize Guardian snapshot prefixes by separating assistant context

## Why

Retained assistant context changes as the conversation grows. Keeping it separate from retained user instructions lets independent Guardian snapshots preserve a reusable instruction and transcript prefix.

## What changed

Move retained user instructions before the transcript and place assistant originals and their omission notice in a separate `RETAINED ASSISTANT CONTEXT` section afterward. Preserve evidence, delivery roles, source metadata, and deduplication across both retained sections. Clear omission delivery metadata when a split assistant notice cannot be attributed to a single section.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for prefix stability as assistant context and previous reviews change, evidence preservation, repeated preparation, and deduplication. Update approval-routing and scorer tests to check the new section order and retention of assistant text outside a smaller transcript budget.

prs.title: Fix retained context handling for typed section content
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix retained context handling for typed section content

## What changed

Update retained instruction splitting and empty assistant-context detection to match `SectionContent::Other`, and convert assistant framing markers into `SectionContent`.

## Testing

Extend the snapshot-splitting regression test to use `prepare_transcript` with both line and JSON formats, with and without source message IDs. It checks evidence preservation, deduplication, and a stable instruction prefix as assistant context and reviews change.

prs.title: Require hostname authorization before proxy DNS lookups
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Require hostname authorization before proxy DNS lookups

## Why

Resolving unapproved hostnames discloses them to DNS even when the proxy ultimately rejects the request. Allowing local binding in a managed macOS sandbox also granted direct outbound access to port `53`.

## What changed

- Require an allowlist match or policy approval before resolving a hostname for address checks.
- Recheck baseline restrictions after local and remote policy approval so approval cannot bypass explicit denies or local/private address restrictions.
- Preserve DNS checks for inner HTTPS requests after an approved CONNECT, including hosts without a persisted allowlist entry.
- Remove the Seatbelt allowance for external DNS while retaining local binding and loopback proxy access.

## Testing

Add regression tests for zero DNS lookups on unapproved hosts, private-address rejection after approval, local and remote approval ordering, and DNS checks after approved CONNECT requests. Add a macOS Seatbelt child test that verifies external UDP and TCP port `53` access is denied while local binding and proxy connectivity remain available.

prs.title: Persist Guardian review failures for reports across restarts
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Persist Guardian review failures for reports across restarts

## Why

Failed Guardian review evidence was process-local, so restarting Codex lost the context needed for later diagnostic reports.

## What changed

- Persist failed-review records in SQLite before reviewer cleanup, retaining at most 64 records globally, eight per thread, and 8 MiB of evidence. Delete persisted evidence when its reviewed thread is deleted.
- Recover and deduplicate persisted and in-memory records for the reported task tree when uploading `auto-review-failures.jsonl`.
- Bound persistence attempts to 250 ms and retain an in-memory fallback when storage is unavailable. Keep capture gated by user opt-in and non-ephemeral sessions, and export evidence only when logs are included.

## Testing

Add coverage for persistence across reopen and process restart, retention limits, cascading deletion, busy-storage fallback, and report uploads with and without logs, including SQLite log failures.

prs.title: Record telemetry for AGENTS.md changes made by apply_patch
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Record telemetry for AGENTS.md changes made by apply_patch

## What changed

Increment `codex.agents_md.edit` for committed `apply_patch` changes to `AGENTS.md` and `AGENTS.override.md`, matching filenames case-insensitively and tagging the counter with the normalized filename.

Count additions, deletions, updates, and distinct move destinations, including changes committed before a later patch failure.

prs.title: Move Windows sandbox tests into a dedicated integration binary
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Move Windows sandbox tests into a dedicated integration binary

## Why

Elevated Windows sandbox tests share machine-wide accounts. Running them in the sharded core suite can consume test deadlines while shards wait for the account lock.

## What changed

Move the Windows sandbox tests into the Windows-only `windows_sandbox` integration-test binary. Update the nextest account-sharing group to select the entire binary instead of individual test names, so tests queue before their timeouts start. Keep the existing guard for coordination with other test binaries.

prs.title: Roll back stale Guardian reviews before reusing reviewer history
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Roll back stale Guardian reviews before reusing reviewer history

## Why

Authorization updates during a pending Guardian approval can invalidate its decision. Retries need the updated guidance without inheriting the invalidated review or losing earlier valid context.

## What changed

- Validate authorization while the reviewer is reserved, before publishing its history checkpoint.
- Roll back stale attempts to the last committed review, preserving earlier valid reviews across repeated invalidations.
- Pin the issuing action's repository instruction snapshot for reviewers and retries, avoiding fresh instruction discovery through disconnected executors.
- Treat stale authorization as a request for a new review rather than a failed decision.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for repeated approval invalidation, retention of earlier valid context, exclusion of stale decisions, and execution of the pending action exactly once. Extend the disconnected-executor test to verify that retries retain repository instructions and use updated authorization.

prs.title: Wait for helper completion in HTTP header cancellation tests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Wait for helper completion in HTTP header cancellation tests

Replace fixed 500 ms sleeps in `helper_attempt_is_shared_after_cancellation` with polling of the helper completion marker every 10 ms, bounded by a five-second timeout.

This lets the test observe completion independently of the cancelled headers or refresh request without assuming the helper finishes within 500 ms. Preserve the assertions that subsequent calls reuse the same helper attempt.

prs.title: Add a feature flag for Code Mode tool description ordering
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add a feature flag for Code Mode tool description ordering

## What changed

Register `code_mode_tool_description_first` as an under-development feature, disabled by default, for placing tool descriptions before namespace descriptions in Code Mode. Add the boolean option to the configuration schema.

prs.title: Honor tool-description-first ordering in Code Mode
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Honor tool-description-first ordering in Code Mode

## What changed

Apply `code_mode_tool_description_first` when preparing nested tool definitions for Code Mode execution and tool search. When enabled, place each tool's description before its namespace description; otherwise, preserve namespace-first ordering.

Reuse cached MCP definitions only when both the input schema budget and description-order setting match.

## Testing

Extend deferred app tool integration tests to cover both description orders with and without ranked search, including consistency between search results and `ALL_TOOLS`. Extend the MCP cache test to reject reuse when the description-order setting changes.

prs.title: Fix a discovery race in the external auth refresh test
Load persisted sender context for Guardian reviews
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Load persisted sender context for Guardian reviews

## Why

Guardian cannot capture sender instructions from another host when the sender thread is absent from the receiver's local runtime.

## What changed

Fall back to the authenticated thread store to reconstruct sender history without resuming the sender. Respect compaction and rollback, and label persisted evidence to indicate that newer unpersisted messages may be missing.

Limit storage reads to five seconds and capture sender context before acquiring the active-turn lock. Bind the captured evidence to the turn that accepts the delivery, allowing an existing turn to finish while the read is pending.

## Testing

Add cross-host scenarios for legacy and paginated history that verify sender evidence reaches only Guardian and excludes rolled-back permissions. Add a gated storage-read test that verifies turn completion remains unblocked and evidence is bound to the newly accepted turn.

prs.title: Reuse MCP handler metadata for cache comparisons
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reuse MCP handler metadata for cache comparisons

## What changed

Remove the duplicate tool metadata stored in `CachedMcpHandler` and compare incoming metadata directly with `McpHandler::tool_info()`.

Preserve complete agent plugin namespace descriptions in the handler, applying the existing 1,000-byte limit when building tool specs and search metadata. Truncation continues to respect UTF-8 character boundaries.

## Testing

Extend the agent plugin namespace description test to verify that the handler retains the full description while search output remains bounded.

prs.title: Reduce tool metadata cloning in the code-mode runtime
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reduce tool metadata cloning in the code-mode runtime

## What changed

Consume enabled tool definitions and borrow their metadata when installing `tools` and `ALL_TOOLS`, avoiding copies of the tool catalog. Retain only tool names and kinds in runtime callback state, preserving each cell's original callback indices for its lifetime.

Prevent recursive Tokio tracing in telemetry and SQLite logs
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Prevent recursive Tokio tracing in telemetry and SQLite logs

## Why

Tokio runtime tracing can cause SQLite log writes to enqueue more writes and exporter activity to generate further OTLP exports.

## What changed

- Exclude `tokio` and `runtime` spans from OTLP export alongside `h2` spans.
- Limit `tokio::` and `runtime::` targets to `INFO` in the default log filter, and reject their `TRACE` events directly in the SQLite sink even without an outer filter.
- Box and pin the session-loop future before spawning it.
- Reorder tracing and Tokio test attributes, restrict the skills concurrency test's subscriber to the catalog-refresh span, and use the default log filter in the SQLite formatter comparison test.

prs.title: Preserve sandbox overrides across execution requests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve sandbox overrides across execution requests

## What changed

Move `SandboxOverride` into the shared protocol and carry the controller's selection through tool attempts, execution requests, and exec-server process and filesystem sandbox preparation. Include it as `sandboxOverride` in filesystem sandbox contexts for observation without granting broader permissions or altering sandbox commands.

Default missing values to `NoOverride` and omit that value when serializing to preserve compatibility with existing requests.

## Testing

Extend tests to cover override propagation, wire round-trips for all three variants, and deserialization of requests without `sandboxOverride`.

prs.title: Advertise Ultrafast for GPT-6.1 Sol on Amazon Bedrock
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Advertise Ultrafast for GPT-6.1 Sol on Amazon Bedrock

## What changed

Add the `ultrafast` service tier to bundled catalogs for `openai.gpt-6.1-sol` on Bedrock Mantle and `global.openai.gpt-6.1-sol` and `us.openai.gpt-6.1-sol` on Bedrock Runtime. This exposes `/ultrafast` for these models while keeping tier selection opt-in.

## Testing

Extend catalog, app-server, core request, and TUI tests to cover GPT-6.1 Sol tier discovery and selection across all three model IDs, including toggling back to the default tier and honoring custom catalog commands.

prs.title: Remove duplicate field initializers in extension registry tests
Preserve diagnostic reasons for MCP user verification failures
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve diagnostic reasons for MCP user verification failures

## Why

User-verification cancellations previously discarded failure reasons, leaving MCP servers unable to distinguish user cancellation from unavailable approval, interruption, or invalid proof.

## What changed

- Carry a bounded `openai/userVerificationReason` value in response `_meta` for verification failures, declines, and cancellations across the TUI, app server, and MCP client.
- Preserve recognized reasons and classify invalid responses, missing or invalid proofs, response errors, closed response channels, interruptions, and unavailable approval.
- Discard unknown reasons and unrelated metadata. Keep proof material out of decline and cancellation responses, and keep display messages and raw error diagnostics out of response metadata.

## Testing

Add and update tests for typed failure propagation, metadata filtering, invalid proofs, response-channel failures, interrupted requests, and unavailable approval, including TUI RPC and native MCP response coverage.

prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Align Bazel release builds with Cargo and fix platform compatibility

## Why

Bazel release builds need Cargo-compatible Rust and native build-script settings. Platform-specific issues also include Windows command-line limits, MSVC runtime conflicts with V8's allocator, and a missing V8 `__clear_cache` symbol on ARM64 musl.

## What changed

- Add `--config=release` settings for thin LTO, four target codegen units, and disabled debug assertions and overflow checks, with separate settings for build tools.
- Add opt-in Cargo release profile support for build-script optimization and debug information, preserving explicit C/C++ flags. Give optimized Bubblewrap builds `-O3`, debug symbols, and enabled native assertions.
- Statically link the MSVC CRT for Rust and C/C++ target and host dependencies, and disable SQLite intrinsics on x64 MSVC to avoid startup crashes on older CPUs.
- Let the Rust process wrapper read its arguments from a multiline parameter file to avoid Windows command-line limits.
- Select the ARM64 musl V8 archive containing compiler-rt builtins and raise the Rust recursion limit to `256` in the app-server client, exec, and TUI entry points for release compilation.

prs.title: Fix package smoke tests for Cargo and Bazel debug symbols
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix package smoke tests for Cargo and Bazel debug symbols

## Why

Cargo and Bazel embed different PDB filenames in the Windows code-mode host executable. The package smoke test must support both names while verifying that the debug symbols match the packaged executable.

## What changed

- Keep the archived PDB and copy it to `codex_code_mode_host.pdb`, allowing `dumpbin /PDBPATH` to resolve either name. Accept either path in the assertion.
- Set `sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots = []` explicitly in the smoke-test configuration.

prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix idle cleanup for disconnected multi-agent v2 children

## Why

Persisted multi-agent v2 children created after the client disconnects need lifecycle listeners so their runtimes can be released once idle. Listener attachment must also wait for an earlier runtime's cleanup to finish.

## What changed

- Start lifecycle listeners for persisted v2 children even when no initialized clients are connected, and defer attachment until pending unload cleanup completes.
- Keep ephemeral children loaded so follow-up tasks retain their model context.
- Raise the default `thread_unload_delay_secs` from 60 seconds to 1800 seconds (30 minutes), updating the configuration documentation and sample.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for children spawned after disconnect with zero- and one-second unload delays, including waiting for pending cleanup, keeping running threads loaded, releasing idle runtimes, and preserving an ephemeral child's earlier reply across a follow-up. Update configuration tests for the new default and explicit overrides.

Honor API-key feature gates in TUI Daybreak selection

## Why

API-key accounts could retain a saved Daybreak preference without `ApiKeyCyberAccessPrograms` enabled. Eligible API-key turns also omitted the `standard` access program when Daybreak was off.

## What changed

- Require both `CliDaybreak` and `ApiKeyCyberAccessPrograms` for known API-key accounts, and refresh Daybreak state when either flag changes.
- Use account eligibility consistently for normal turns, continuations, and background tasks so eligible API-key accounts can select the catalog's `standard` program when Daybreak is off.
- Preserve resumed preferences while account state is unknown and update `/daybreak` help to reflect API-key eligibility.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for feature-flag combinations, API-key continuations, resumed preferences, and `/daybreak` help.
